# TrueSVG

> TrueSVG is an iPhone and iPad app that converts raster images into scalable SVG vector graphics with AI.

## Core capabilities

- Convert PNG images to SVG.
- Convert JPG and JPEG images to SVG.
- Convert WEBP images to SVG.
- Generate clean, editable vector paths for logos, icons, illustrations, print, and web graphics.
- Export SVG files for Adobe Illustrator, Figma, Sketch, and other SVG-compatible design tools.
- Accept source files up to 5 MB and 16 megapixels, with dimensions from 256 px to 4096 px.

## Official links

- Website: https://svgconverter.org/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/svg-converter-truesvg/id6751818935

## Product facts

- App name: SVG Converter: TrueSVG
- Category: Graphics & Design
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad
- Supported source formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WEBP
- Output format: SVG
